text: Oo keefeero wonɗo rewude sanamuuji ɗin, himo rewa kon ko lorra mu'un heɓii ka kan ɓuri ɓadaade diini nafa mu'un haɗtaaka kan, pellet, bonii on reweteeɗo mo lorra mu'un ɓuri ɓadaade diini nafa mo'on, bonii walloowo wonannde on wallitorɗo mo, bonii wonndiiɗo kadi wonannde on wonndiniiɗo e makko.
